from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,struct,zlib,importlib.util,shutil,sys
r=Path('.local/step07-review/independent-round13');spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('independent',r/'zip-oracle.py');oracle=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(oracle)
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();downloads=[];negative=[];metrics=[]
modes=sys.argv[1:] or ['production','dev']
prefix='partial-'+modes[0]+'-' if len(modes)==1 else ''
for mode in modes:
 base=Path('.local/step07/browser')/mode;e=json.loads((base/'evidence.json').read_text());assert e['sourceCommit']=='1be820a5adfbb3c41c532fbc778958774ed1c470';assert not e['errors'];assert all('422' in x['text'] for x in e['consoleMessages'] if x['type']=='error');assert len(e['pixelChecks'])==8 and all(x['actualSha']==x['independentReferenceSha'] for x in e['pixelChecks']);metrics.append({'mode':mode,'source':e['sourceCommit'],'actualCanvasSamples':8,'allIndependentReferenceEqual':True,'pageErrors':e['errors'],'consoleErrors':[x for x in e['consoleMessages'] if x['type']=='error'],'native':e['native'],'projectId':e['projectId'],'first':e['first'],'second':e['second'],'retiredCurrent':e['retired'],'NO.env':True})
 for pos in ['first','second','history']:
  src=base/(pos+'-export.zip');b=src.read_bytes();details=oracle.artifact(b);assert details['source']==e['sourceCommit'];files=oracle.parse(b);m=json.loads(files['manifest.json']);identity=m['identity'];fp=sha(json.dumps(identity,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode());assert m['buildId']=='step05-pack-'+e['sourceCommit'][:12]+'-'+fp[:16]
  for name in ['A1.png','A2.png']:
   png=files[name];assert png[:8]==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n';at=8
   while at<len(png):
    n=struct.unpack_from('>I',png,at)[0];chunk=png[at+4:at+8+n];assert zlib.crc32(chunk)==struct.unpack_from('>I',png,at+8+n)[0];at+=n+12
   assert at==len(png)
  dst=r/'evidence/archives'/mode/src.name;dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copy2(src,dst)
  downloads.append({'mode':mode,'downloadPosition':pos,'path':str(dst.relative_to(r)),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':sha(b),'artifact':details,'canonicalBuildIDVerified':True,'PNGChunkCRCVerified':True})
  central=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,len(b)-6)[0]
  for case,offset,new in [('central-crc',central+16,bytes([b[central+16]^1])),('local-crc',14,bytes([b[14]^1])),('eocd-count',len(b)-14,struct.pack('<HH',9,9))]:
   v=bytearray(b);v[offset:offset+len(new)]=new;p=r/'private/archive-negative'/mode/(pos+'-'+case+'.zip');p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(v)
   try:oracle.parse(v)
   except Exception as error:message=str(error)
   else:raise AssertionError('Bad ZIP accepted')
   negative.append({'mode':mode,'position':pos,'case':case,'path':str(p.relative_to(r)),'bytes':len(v),'sha256':sha(v),'outerSHARecomputed':True,'independentRejected':True,'error':message})
 assert (base/'first-export.zip').read_bytes()==(base/'history-export.zip').read_bytes()
(r/('evidence/'+prefix+'latest-browser-archive-verification.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'downloads':downloads,'downloadsCount':len(downloads),'PNGDecodes':len(downloads)*2,'distinctExportBuildIds':len(set(x['artifact']['exportBuildId'] for x in downloads)),'historyBytesEqualFirst':True},indent=2)+'\n')
(r/('evidence/'+prefix+'latest-archive-negative-verification.json')).write_text(json.dumps(negative,indent=2)+'\n');(r/('evidence/'+prefix+'full-browser-metrics.json')).write_text(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'normalDownloads':len(downloads),'PNGDecodes':len(downloads)*2,'negativeRejected':len(negative),'canvasSamples':sum(x['actualCanvasSamples'] for x in metrics)}))
